notes.title: Update 2022
notes.notes: What can I say, play and find out yourself ;)

notes.title: A Short Update about the Playtests
notes.notes:
Future Presidents! Dear Testers!

We have important news to share! 
We are pausing I Am Your President playtests, so we can focus on the bug fixes and polishing features. We are giving ourselves a timeframe of around a month, after which we would like to come back. Our return will bring more content, (hopefully) fewer bugs. When we come back, we will also open the playtests to everyone! 

Thank you for your patience and see you in the playtests!

If you have any questions, join our Discord and ask ahead!

notes.title: Third week patch
notes.notes:
Hello there!
Long time passed since last patch but here it comes. It contains some life improvements, blocker fixes and we also started working on tutorials (many of graphics and text are just placeholder). You may or may not see them yet.

Also added 75 people. Please welcome them!

notes.title: Graph of stats changes
notes.notes:
You can now click Stats Icon to see Graph of summary changes per turn for each statistics.

Adding 50 more people!

notes.title: Quick Patch Fixing Dialogue Blocker
notes.notes:
There was some problem with opening dialogues. After downloading this patch it should be working fine.

Thank you for patience!

notes.title: Big patch size explanation
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Once again sorry for the size of this patch. I don't know if this is an scene switch issue or every time compression is made Change everything for steam. I promise I will find out and about patch:

Fixed issues with projects mostly.

Next week expect conent updates for projects and map events.

notes.title: Back to older version but kept lower game size
notes.notes:
New patch uploading right now - it does not have much - we tried to fix blocker bug where dialogue just stops from progressing for some users. Unfortunalty yesterday solution didn't work, so I returned game enginge to previous version. Also I fixed some things and added checker for dialogues - they will check if there answers appear as they should and will send notification if they don't. That way I will gather more info to fix this bug and how much people experience it.

Also adding 10 more people to playtest.

Update download size maybe big once again, sorry. As far as I know there won't be such big changes anymore BUT using new compression method I reduced game size from around 9 GB to 3,5 GB and on release it can weight even less.

notes.title: Minor Changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed text sprites placements in projects
- There is now hint of what to do in Summary Feature,
- President's name inputed by user in questionnaire will now show up in Summary 'signed by' box.
